para: ingredient, hidden in the label, what it really contains, read the fine print
ficha: glass bottle with the photo on its label; a light beam scans it and on the golpe rips one line out as a big tag. Golpe = the ingredient, 1-2 words.
a heavy rubber stamp drops on a printed photo and leaves the golpe in ink. Var b greys the photo out. Golpe = 1-2 words.

para: study, patients, groups, most people, only one of them
ficha: crowd of little figures on a grid; on the golpe it splits in two groups under hanging photos and one group lights up. Var uno: one figure steps forward.

para: routine, daily cycle, steps that repeat, it all comes back
ficha: ring of 3-6 round photos; a light travels and turns each on at its word; the golpe closes the circle inside.

para: barrier, protection, blocked; or breaking through, it falls apart
ficha: var sube: bricks rise over the photo, last one lands on the golpe with the word on the wall. Var cae: wall made of photo 1 explodes showing photo 2.

para: goes deep, under the surface, layers, it reaches the
ficha: 3D block cut open with the photo on top; a drop sinks layer by layer, each named at its word; the golpe names the deepest layer it hits. Do not repeat a layer label in the golpe.

para: what you cannot see, inside, in reality, behind appearances
ficha: a magnifier searches photo 1 and through its glass shows photo 2; on the golpe the glass swallows the whole frame.

para: compare two things, which one wins, worth more, weighs more
ficha: balance scale with a photo on each pan; on the golpe one side crashes down and the other greys out.

para: how much each one has, amounts, ranking, too much of one
ficha: 2-4 glass jars with photo labels fill at their word; on the golpe the key jar overflows and the rest go grey.
